items.title: Nifty in oversold territory; pullback to 24,000 possible: Analysts
items.description: The Nifty 50 has declined and is now near oversold levels. Analysts suggest a potential pullback towards 24,000 if support at 23,600 is maintained. Traders are advised to consider specific option strategies for the upcoming weekly expiry. Several top stock picks are recommended with defined targets and stop losses. These include Azad Engineering, Laurus Labs, RR Kabel, and Astra Microwave Products.

items.title: Stock Radar: PI Industries showing signs of a rebound after 30% fall from highs; time to buy?
items.description: PI Industries stock bounced back after testing crucial support levels.  The pharma stock made a double bottom pattern around 2500-2600 levels.  Experts suggest buying for a possible target above 2800 levels.  The supertrend indicator triggered a buy call, indicating upward momentum.  The stock is trading above key long-term moving averages.

items.title: Credit card issuance hits strongest pace in more than two years
items.description: The additions were led, once again, by the country's largest issuers. HDFC Bank topped the list, adding 163,000 net new credit cards and edging past SBI Cards, which added 162,000. ICICI Bank added 151,000 cards, while Federal Bank continued its strong momentum with 101,000 net new additions.

items.title: Zen Technologies shares fall 6% after Q1FY27 profit drops 28%, revenue declines 10% YoY
items.description: Zen Technologies shares fell significantly after reporting lower first-quarter profits and revenue. The company experienced a revenue decline of over 10% year-on-year. Management highlighted a robust order pipeline and improved execution visibility for upcoming quarters. Zen Technologies closed the quarter with a substantial order book of over Rs 1,000 crore. Institutional investor interest in the company has shown a notable increase recently.

items.title: Bank of Baroda shares fall 2% after Q1 earnings. Why are brokerages slashing target prices?
items.description: Bank of Baroda shares fell after a sharp 72% drop in Q1 net profit due to a one-off NMC Health settlement. Brokerages cut target prices despite stable core performance. Margins, fee income and upcoming ECL norms remain key concerns, though asset quality and loan growth trends offer some support.

items.title: Saregama India among 5 stocks that closed above VWAP, signaling bullish shift
items.description: On July 24, the closing prices of five stocks in the Nifty500 pack rallied over 2% relative to their VWAP (Volume Weighted Average Price), and a shift above the VWAP suggests a potential bullish trend, according to stockedge.com's technical scan data.When the closing price rises above the VWAP, it signifies that the closing price is higher than the average price at which it was traded throughout the day, with the average being weighted by trading volume. This occurrence is often interpreted as a potential bullish signal by traders and investors. Potentially indicating positive sentiment in the market.

items.title: Tata Consumer shares jump 3% after Q1 results. Here’s why Nomura, Motilal see strong upside potential
items.description: Tata Consumer Products shares rose 3% after the FMCG major reported a 27.8% YoY jump in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 427 crore, while revenue increased 11.9% to Rs 5,349 crore. Brokerages remain bullish, with Nomura reiterating a Buy rating and raising its target price to Rs 1,475, citing calibrated price hikes, margin resilience and expectations of sustained double-digit sales growth.

items.title: This jewellery stock appeared in 4 of June’s top 10 PMS portfolios, one bet was as high as 22.6%
items.description: Thangamayil Jewellery emerged as a top stock choice for several leading PMS fund managers.  Equirus Wealth made the largest allocation, showing strong conviction in the company.  This interest follows significant growth in Thangamayil's operations and financial performance.  The jeweller's expansion into Chennai is a key driver for future revenue projections.  Future plans include further store openings and market share growth within Tamil Nadu.

items.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex soars 600 points, Nifty above 23,900. 6 key factors driving the rally
items.description: The Indian stock market ended its losing streak as tensions between Iran and the US eased. Falling crude oil prices also contributed to a significant boost in investor sentiment. The Sensex and Nifty experienced sharp gains, adding substantial value to market capitalization. IndiGo and Asian Paints shares led the upward movement across major indices. Broader markets and most sectoral indices also traded firmly in the green.

items.title: Hindustan Zinc shares gain 2% as Q1 net profit soars 145% YoY. Should you buy, sell or hold?
items.description: Hindustan Zinc shares: The company posted a robust Q1 FY27 performance, prompting several brokerages to reiterate their 'Buy' ratings. The Vedanta Group firm's net profit jumped 145% YoY to Rs 5,469 crore, while revenue surged 77% YoY to Rs 13,747 crore. Total expenses rose 33% YoY to Rs 6,749 crore, reflecting higher operating activity during the quarter.

items.title: Gulf Lloyds shares set for market debut today. Here's what GMP suggests ahead of listing
items.description: Gulf Lloyds (India) is set to debut on the BSE SME platform on July 27, with grey market premium (GMP) trends indicating a largely flat listing. The Rs 18.19-crore IPO was subscribed 10.85 times overall, led by strong retail participation, while the company plans to use the proceeds for capital expenditure, debt repayment, and working capital.

items.title: IDFC First Bank shares soar 9% after Q1 profit jumps 132% to Rs 1,075 crore. What are analysts saying?
items.description: IDFC First Bank share price gained 9% after it reported its highest-ever quarterly profit after tax of Rs 1,075 crore. Net interest income rose 21.1% year-on-year, and net interest margin also improved. Gross non-performing assets fell to 1.51%, showing further improvement in asset quality. The bank received claims worth Rs 514.8 crore under the CGFMU scheme. Management remains focused on building a high-quality banking institution with strong governance.

items.title: AU Small Finance Bank shares rally 5% as Q1 PAT jumps 37% to Rs 796 crore, NII up 32% YoY
items.description: AU Small Finance Bank share price jumped 5% after it reported a 37% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 796 crore for the June quarter, driven by strong growth in net interest income and advances. The lender also announced July 31, 2026, as the record date for its proposed final dividend and elevated COO Yogesh Jain as Deputy CEO.

items.title: PVR Inox among 5 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
items.description: On July 24, five stocks in the Nifty500 appeared on the 'White Marubozu' bullish scanner, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern in technical analysis that occurs when the opening price is the lowest for a given period and the closing price is the highest.Represented by a long white (or green) candlestick with no upper shadow and a small or nonexistent lower shadow, it indicates strong buying pressure throughout the session. Traders interpret it as a signal that buyers were in control from the opening to the closing, often using such patterns to assess the potential continuation of upward momentum.

items.title: Atul among 5 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
items.description: On July 24, five stocks in the Nifty500 pack were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge.com. An uptrend signal is generated when the RSI value crosses above 50 from lower levels. “RSI trending up” indicates that Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are rising, suggesting strengthening momentum in the stock’s price action. This can indicate potential upward movement and is often used by traders to identify buying opportunities in momentum-driven markets.
